#!/bin/sh
# activate-golden.sh — the one command for deploying a new version.
#
#   sudo ./activate-golden.sh
#
# Run it after the release build and seal:
#   CXXFLAGS="-include cstdint" cargo build --workspace --release
#   sudo target/release/opblob seal-shm && sudo target/release/opblob persist
# OP_RELEASE_DIR selects one prepared optimized artifact directory for both
# release-controller verification and golden preparation (default target/release).
#
# What it does:
# 1. Native provision-slots reconciles any interrupted transaction and prepares
#    the owned golden/slot layout. Recovery-only work stops this invocation.
# 2. Prepares /opt/op-dbus/golden from target/release and the sealed catalog
#    (internal helper deploy/lib/golden/build-golden.sh; it never builds or seals).
# 3. Native release sends/receives the immutable generation into the inactive
#    slot, rotates read-only overlays at the inventory's owned host targets,
#    and restores affected consumers' wanted states. Only active + previous remain.
#
# Undo the last release:
#   sudo /usr/local/libexec/opdbus-release/op-release-launch rollback
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
LC_ALL=C
export PATH LC_ALL

REPO=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$(readlink -f "$0")")" && pwd)
OP_RELEASE_DIR=$(realpath -e -- "${OP_RELEASE_DIR:-"$REPO/target/release"}")
export OP_RELEASE_DIR
RELEASE_BASE=/usr/local/libexec/opdbus-release
RELEASE_LAUNCH=$RELEASE_BASE/op-release-launch
RELEASE_BIN=$RELEASE_BASE/op-release
RELEASE_BOOT=/etc/init.d/op-release-activate

[ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || { echo 'activate-golden.sh: run as root (sudo ./activate-golden.sh)' >&2; exit 1; }
[ "$#" = 0 ] || { echo 'activate-golden.sh: takes no arguments' >&2; exit 1; }
# Check the execution path before invoking any installed kit code. The launcher
# independently checks the complete approved manifest and kernel/BTF pair.
for directory in / /usr /usr/local /usr/local/libexec "$RELEASE_BASE" /etc /etc/init.d; do
    directory_mode=0$(stat -c %a "$directory")
    [ -d "$directory" ] && [ ! -L "$directory" ] &&
        [ "$(stat -c %u:%g "$directory")" = 0:0 ] &&
        [ "$((directory_mode & 07022))" -eq 0 ] ||
        { echo "activate-golden.sh: insecure release-kit directory: $directory" >&2; exit 1; }
done
for artifact in "$RELEASE_LAUNCH" "$RELEASE_BIN" "$RELEASE_BOOT"; do
    [ -f "$artifact" ] && [ ! -L "$artifact" ] &&
        [ "$(stat -c %u:%g:%a:%h "$artifact")" = 0:0:755:1 ] ||
        { echo "activate-golden.sh: install the approved root-owned release kit: $artifact" >&2; exit 1; }
done
cmp -s "$RELEASE_LAUNCH" "$REPO/deploy/release/op-release-launch" &&
    cmp -s "$RELEASE_BIN" "$OP_RELEASE_DIR/op-release" &&
    cmp -s "$RELEASE_BOOT" "$REPO/deploy/release/op-release-activate" ||
    { echo 'activate-golden.sh: installed release kit differs from this build; refusing an old or mixed kit' >&2; exit 1; }

"$RELEASE_LAUNCH" provision-slots

---

### 1. Why the release won't install into the slot (Rollback on Service Restore)

The Btrfs snapshot send/receive into the inactive slot (`slot b`) actually succeeds. However, during the activation phase when `op-release` rotates the read-only overlays and brings supervised services up, **`op-grpc-bridge` crashes on startup**:

```text
op-grpc-bridge: Consolidated Operation gRPC bridge starting ... plugin_id=tched_router
Error: sealed plugin not found: tched_router
```

* **Root Cause**: In recent workspace changes, `tched_router` was renamed to `chat_router` in [`crates/op-plugins`](file:///srv/git/odbus-verified/crates/op-plugins). When `opblob seal-shm` seals the plugin catalog, it produces `chat_router.blob` instead of `tched_router.blob`. However, `op-grpc-bridge` is still configured to require `tched_router`.
* **The Result**: `sv -w 30 check op-grpc-bridge` times out after 30 seconds. Because service restoration failed, `op-release` triggers an automatic rollback (`recovery::revert_activation`), cleanly unwinding the rotating overlays back to `slot a` and restoring the original services.

---

### 2. Why `--system` is not working with the rotating overlay

The `--system` flag fails across three architectural gates:

1. **Launcher Argument Gate ([`op-release-launch`](file:///srv/git/odbus-verified/deploy/release/op-release-launch#L28-L32))**:
   `op-release-launch` enforces single-argument invocations for release commands:
   ```sh
   release|deploy|provision-slots|status|rollback|abort|boot) [ "$#" -eq 1 ] || exit 2 ;;
   ```
   Passing `--system` via [`deploy.sh`](file:///srv/git/odbus-verified/deploy.sh#L100) (`op-release-launch deploy --system`) causes the launcher to immediately exit with code 2.

2. **Overlay Overlap Invariant ([`system.rs`](file:///srv/git/odbus-verified/crates/op-deployment/src/bin/release/system.rs#L98-L99))**:
   The base-system payload engine in `system.rs` strictly rejects any destination that overlaps with the rotating overlay mount targets:
   ```rust
   ensure!(targets.iter().chain(overlays).all(|p| !overlaps(&entry.path, p)),
       "system destination overlaps an overlay target or mount: {}", entry.path.display());
   ```
   If any base payload file (e.g. under `/etc/sv/` or `/usr/local/libexec/`) overlaps an active or incoming overlay target, validation aborts before any filesystem modification.

3. **Codebase Wiring Disconnect**:
   [`crates/op-deployment/src/bin/release/system.rs`](file:///srv/git/odbus-verified/crates/op-deployment/src/bin/release/system.rs) is currently an untracked file in the worktree and is not included (`mod system;`) in [`crates/op-deployment/src/bin/release/mod.rs`](file:///srv/git/odbus-verified/crates/op-deployment/src/bin/release/mod.rs). 1. **Removes the stray helper files** in `/opt/op-dbus/golden/libexec/3tched/` (`op-chat-responder@.service` and `recover-3tchedfs`) that violate the golden helper manifest and cause `build-golden.sh` to halt.

You can save this to `/srv/git/odbus-verified/deploy-fix.sh` and run `sudo bash /srv/git/odbus-verified/deploy-fix.sh`:

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

REPO="/srv/git/odbus-verified"

rm -f /opt/op-dbus/golden/libexec/3tched/op-chat-responder@.service
rm -f /opt/op-dbus/golden/libexec/3tched/recover-3tchedfs

echo "==> 2. Sealing and persisting catalog..."
target/release/opblob seal-shm
target/release/opblob persist

echo "==> 3. Running provision-slots..."
/usr/local/libexec/opdbus-release/op-release-launch provision-slots

deploy/lib/golden/build-golden.sh
